verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a statistics engine behind its experiments: results report metric lifts with confidence intervals, setup includes power analysis, and its measurement suite includes CUPED variance reduction and stratified sampling. A practitioner on HN praised its balance of statistical rigor and speed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the methodology (frequentist vs Bayesian, test types, sequential testing), clear evidence that CUPED applies beyond the Warehouse Native context, independent verification of result correctness.
